notes: HOF-500 re-measurement of b24a-fc320noisseed1: every checkpoint that scored >=97% in the closeout (43 of them), at 500 fresh episodes, gate 97 with early abandonment -- a checkpoint stops the moment >15 losses make 97% unreachable, so shrinking ones bail fast and only genuine >=97%/500 holders run full length. EVAL_OUT_SUFFIX=_hof500 keeps results in *_checkpoint_evals_hof500.json, off the committed closeout file. One of four jobs (one per b24 arm) meant to run as 4 parallel eval processes; priority 8 puts them in the eval wave ahead of b25 closeouts. arch.json rebuilds the fc320 net; SNEK_FC_LAYERS=320 is belt-and-suspenders.
